title: Catch the Goose 3D
description: Rummage through a bustling 3D pile of everyday props and farm items, match three identical objects in your tray, and clear the entire mountain to catch the elusive big goose.
controls: Tap 3D objects in the pile to send them into your bottom tray; match three identical items to clear them before the tray fills up.

zh-CN.title: 抓大鹅 3D
zh-CN.description: 微信畅玩榜现象级爆款抓大鹅 3D：在堆满立体萌物的 3D 大盆里眼疾手快挑出三个相同物品消除，清空全场抓住大鹅！
zh-CN.controls: 点击盆中立体物品放入下方槽位，凑齐三个相同物品即可消除，清空全部关卡道具即可通关抓鹅。
